## ALEX MORGAN

San Francisco, CA | +1 (555) 234-5678 | alex.morgan@example.com | linkedin.com/in/alexmorgan-dev | github.com/alexmorgan-tech

## CAREER OBJECTIVE

Computer Science undergraduate (B.Tech, 2028) with a GPA of 8.76, specialising in full-stack web development and interactive systems. Demonstrated experience in building AI-driven frontend interfaces and scalable React.js applications in a production environment. Active hackathon participant - Top 10 among 1,000+ developers at Vibeathon 2025. Passionate about data structure visualisation, component-based architecture, and delivering clean, user-centric products.

## EDUCATION

## Bachelor of Technology - Computer Science & Engineering

Vidya Jyothi Institute of Technology, Hyderabad GPA: 8.76 / 10

## Intermediate (Science - MPC)

2024 - 2028 (Expected)

2022 - 2024

Narayana Junior College, Hyderabad

Percentage: 94.8%

## Secondary School Certificate (SSC)

Graduated 2022

ZPHS Nagole, Hyderabad

Percentage: 93.0%

## INTERNSHIP EXPERIENCE

## AI Frontend Developer Intern

Jan 2026 - Mar 2026

EnviGuide · Hyderabad, India · On-site, Full-Time

- Developed AI-driven frontend interfaces for production-level web applications using React.js.
- Built reusable, scalable UI components to visualise dynamic AI-generated outputs with clean state management.
- Designed fully responsive UI systems with a focus on performance optimisation and accessibility.
- Integrated AI-based features into interactive dashboards and user workflows.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams (design, backend, product) to iteratively refine the user experience.
- Participated in agile sprint cycles, contributing to continuous feature releases in a live environment.

## PROJECTS

## AlgoScope - Algorithm Visualisation Tool | React.js · JavaScript · Canvas API · Vercel

github.com/alexmorgan-tech/AlgoScope

- Built an interactive algorithm visualisation platform to aid DSA learning, covering sorting, searching, and graph algorithms.
- Implemented step-by-step animation with dynamic memory trace visualisation and auxiliary data structure mapping.
- Optimised rendering performance to maintain smooth animations for computationally intensive algorithm states.
- Deployed publicly on Vercel; designed with a beginner-friendly UI for educational accessibility.

## TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: Python, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript Frontend: React.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS Backend: Node.js, Express.js Databases: MongoDB, Firebase, SQL, PostgreSQL Cloud & Deployment: Vercel, Render, AWS (EC2, S3 - Basics) Tools: Git, GitHub, Cursor Concepts: REST APIs, DSA, Responsive Design, Component-Based Architecture, State Management

## ACHIEVEMENTS & ACTIVITIES

Among 1,000+ participants

- Built a student upskilling platform end-to-end within 36 hours, placing in the top 10.
- Strengthened rapid prototyping, team collaboration, and creative problem-solving under pressure.

## VIBE Coder - Full Stack Project Development

- Designed and implemented responsive UI components for complex data visualisation systems.
- Collaborated to enforce consistent design language and maintainable code practices.
- Contributed to end-to-end development including frontend logic and backend integration.

## CORE STRENGTHS

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, maintained through continuous DSA practice.
- Rapid learner with a track record of adapting to new frameworks, tools, and workflows.
- Effective communicator and team collaborator, proven across hackathons and cross-functional project work.

## HOBBIES

- Coding and building web applications
- Reading tech documentation
- Exploring new AI tools

## LANGUAGES KNOWN

Telugu, Hindi, English

## DECLARATION

I hereby declare that all the information provided above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. I take full responsibility for the authenticity of the details mentioned in this resume.

Place: Hyderabad

Date: 13 March 2026

Alex Morgan
